{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Venezuela|Cuisine of Venezuela]]

'''Pabellón criollo''' is Venezuela's national dish, and no visit to this South American country will be complete unless you try it. This flavorful dish consists of shredded flank steak, black beans, rice, plantains or bananas, onions, tomatoes, and spices. The end result and presentation should resemble the national flag, hence the name of the dish. It is traditionally served with [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantains]], [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]] and [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]].

==Ingredients==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] finely chopped [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (14 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) tinned chopped [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* ½ tsp ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 900 g (2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|lean steak]], (sirloin or rump), about 12 mm (½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) thick

==Procedure==
# Heat the oil in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], add the onions and garlic and cook over a medium heat for about 5 minutes until the onions are soft and transparent.
# Add the tomatoes, cumin and salt, mix well, reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered, for about 30 minutes, stirring often, until the tomato juices evaporate and the sauce becomes thick. 
# 15 minutes before the end of the cooking time, preheat the [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] to hot, place the steak on the grill pan and cook under the grill for 5 minute on each side. 
# Remove from the grill and cut into pieces about 12mm/ ½-inch long and 6mm/ ¼-inch wide then add the strips of beef to the sauce, mixing well.
